source_review.notes: Checked Semantic Versioning 2.0.0, the current Protocol Buffers proto3 evolution guide, Apache Avro 1.12.0 specification, W3C Data on the Web Best Practices, JSON Schema Draft 2020-12 Core, ISO/IEC 11179-3:2023, HL7 FHIR Release 5 version management, and OASIS UBL 2.4. Claims remain bounded to each source's public-contract version rules, format evolution, schema resolution, dataset-version guidance, schema identity and dialect, registry metamodel, specification/profile versioning, or customization/version scope.
